# Robin Farrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Eight years old  <sub>[v2 c27 P4](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0004), [v3 c1 P31](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0031), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Welby  <sub>[v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Second-primer schoolboy  <sub>[v2 c27 P5](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0005)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Robin  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033)</sub>; Robin-boy  <sub>[v3 c1 P34](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0034), [v3 c28 P2](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Robin is an attractive young boy with a round skull covered in tiny, fuzzy yellow ringlets. He has a snubbed nose, a perpetually smiling mouth, and a single dimple in one cheek that gives him a sweet, amusing, uneven appearance when he chuckles. His face harbors joy and playfulness, with eyes that dance with an elfish roguishness.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c20 P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 c20 P9](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0009)_

## Personality

Robin is a mischievous, cheerful, and rascal-like boy who possesses a natural gift for capturing affection. He has an active inquisitiveness and regularly asks challenging or unusual questions about the world and religious topics. Though careless and prone to forgetting his responsibilities, he is good-humoured, enthusiastic, and easily comforted. He also pulls dreadful faces and enjoys teasing others or tormenting animals.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 c9 P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 c9 P22](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0022), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c19 P20](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0020), [v2 c25 P41](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0041), [v3 c38 P9](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0009)_

## History

Following the death of his mother in East Welby, Robin and his twin sister Lucy were taken in by their relative Thirza Abernethy to live at Grey Shutters. During the journey to his new home, Robin's energetic misbehavior distressed Thirza, though he quickly grew deeply attached to Nell Harcourt. Shortly after arriving, he developed a competitive dislike for Cedric Stanhope and began engaging in frequent pranks, such as plucking bird feathers, exploring the well, and accidentally ruining lemon pies. After starting school, he became close friends with his desk partner Milty Gammon and gradually warmed up to Cedric. Later, when Mrs. Agatha Sowerby forbade him from fishing with the Cottons, Robin rebelled by skipping Sunday school to go fishing with them in secret. Upon Nell's return from absences, Robin warmly welcomed her and continued his schooling and village life at Grey Shutters.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c9 P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 c9 P22](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0022), [v2 c17 P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 c21 P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 c27 P5](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0005), [v3 c13 P7](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0007), [v3 c13 P37](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0037), [v3 c22 P17](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0017)_
